text.p: Horizon Group Inc, a developer of outlet centers, said Monday it had completed a refinancing transaction and bought the remaining interest in a venture.

Horizon said it completed a two-year loan from Lehman Brothers for $300.6 million, with an initial funding of $212.1 million. The loan agreement provides for access to an additional $88.5 million, part of which is subject to further collateralization of the loan.
Horizon said it purchased the outstanding joint venture interest in Horizon's outlet center in Gilroy, Calif.

Net proceeds of the Lehman loan have been used to repay the outstanding balance of the company's revolving credit and construction financing facilities with First National Bank of Chicago and Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce and five other loan facilities.

"We feel this facility achieves this goal while maintaining a market rate of interest," President James Wassel said in a statement. "As we execute our business plan to improve the performance of the company and also pledge additional assets, we'll be able to draw additional capital from this facility," he said.
Horizon is a real estate investment trust that owns, operates and develops outlet centers in the United States.
